title: 第9章 葬骨丘第10章 系统任务经验获取
slug: 开局废了我开启最强进化
content_zh:
直接出示过身份识别卡，守卫完全没有阻拦，非常顺利。
像叶凌这样的学生出城，这些守卫已经见得太多了。
只不过几乎都有其他人同行，叶凌算得上是个另类，竟然一人出行。
叶凌终于踏出了天辉城。
离开了南门，就代表着自己正式进入到了魔兽的地盘。
在这野外，生存只能靠自己，无法指望别人来拯救自己。
在城市周围，靠城市比较近的，都是一些比较低级的魔兽。
高级魔兽，一般都是处在距离城市比较远的地方。
距离城市周围很近的地方，原本也不是没有高级魔兽存在，只不过都已经被讨伐掉了。
很无奈，叶凌目前并没有坐骑类别的灵宠，因此只能徒步前行。
不过为了自己的安全，叶凌在离开南门之后，第一时间就召唤出了血幽。
在野外，怎么小心谨慎都不为过。
因为一个不小心，就有可能跌入万丈深渊，万劫不复。
小心驶得万年船，因此血幽必须在叶凌身边。
在离开之前，叶凌准备了一些东西，其中就有关于天辉城周围的地图。
上面有着怪物的分布，靠南门这边，距离比较近的，有几个魔物的聚集地。
而这一次，叶凌的目标就是其中的一个。
柿子自然是要挑软的捏，为了自己的安全，叶凌选择的地方名字叫葬骨丘。
顾名思义，这个地方就是属于亡灵属类别的骷髅魔物生存的地方。
之所以选择来这里，叶凌同样也是为了收集血幽下一次进化的材料。

血幽每一次进化，都需要消耗一定的材料才行。
第一次进化是系统免费送的，而后面的进化材料，需要叶凌自己去慢慢的弄。
血幽想要进化到下一阶段的灰眼僵尸，所需要的材料有四种。
当然，之所以只有四种，是因为现在成长力并不高。
等到了后面的时候，所需要的进化材料会越来越多。
四种材料分别是，无瑕之骨、黑暗之心、次级黑暗结晶X10、暗黑精血X10。
而在这葬骨丘，就有机会获得其中两种材料，一种就是无暇之骨，还有一种就是次级黑暗结晶。
走了约莫半个钟头后，穿过一片片丛林，叶凌终于来到了自己本次的目的地，葬骨丘。
先前还是一片丛林，看上去绿油油的，生机盎然。
但是眼前这里，确实死寂一片，甚至可以说是寸草不生。
葬骨丘所在的位置，完全没有一丝生机可言。
就算是树木，也没有一点绿叶在上面，全部都是一些枯枝烂叶的枯树。
也不知道是不是由于葬骨丘真的是骨头比较多的缘故，地面上的石头看上去也都是白的。
content_en:
I showed my ID card directly, and the guard didn't stop me at all. It was very smooth.
These guards have seen too many students like Ye Ling out of the city.
But almost everyone else was traveling with them. Ye Ling was an outlier, traveling alone.
Ye Ling finally stepped out of Tianhui City.
Leaving the south gate means that you have officially entered the territory of Warcraft.
In this wilderness, you can only rely on yourself to survive, and you cannot rely on others to save you.
Around the city, those closest to the city are relatively low-level monsters.
High-level monsters are usually located far away from the city.
There were originally no high-level monsters in places very close to the city, but they had all been conquered.
Unfortunately, Ye Ling currently does not have a mount-type spiritual pet, so he can only move forward on foot.
However, for his own safety, Ye Ling summoned Xueyou as soon as he left the south gate.
In the wild, you can never be too careful.
Because if you are not careful, you may fall into the abyss and be destroyed.
Be careful to sail the ten-thousand-year ship, so Xue You must be by Ye Ling's side.
Before leaving, Ye Ling prepared some things, including a map around Tianhui City.
There is a distribution of monsters on it. Near the south gate, there are several monster gathering places relatively close.
And this time, Ye Ling's target was one of them.
Naturally, you have to pick the softest persimmons. For your own safety, Ye Ling chose the place called Bone Burial Hill.
As the name suggests, this place is where skeleton monsters belonging to the undead category live.
The reason why Ye Ling chose to come here was also to collect materials for Xueyou's next evolution.
Every time Xueyou evolves, it needs to consume certain materials.
The first evolution is given free of charge by the system, but Ye Ling needs to slowly prepare the subsequent evolution materials by himself.
If Xueyou wants to evolve to the next stage of gray-eyed zombie, he needs four kinds of materials.
Of course, the reason why there are only four types is because the current growth rate is not high.
Later on, more and more evolutionary materials will be needed.
The four materials are: Flawless Bone, Heart of Darkness, Secondary Dark Crystal X10, and Dark Essence X10.
In this Bone Burial Mound, there is a chance to obtain two of the materials, one is the flawless bone, and the other is the secondary dark crystal.
After walking for about half an hour, through patches of jungle, Ye Ling finally arrived at his destination this time, the Bone Burial Mound.
It was still a jungle before, looking green and full of life.
But here in front of me, it is indeed completely silent, and it can even be said that there is no grass growing.
The location of the Bone Burial Mound was completely devoid of life.
Even the trees don't have any green leaves on them, they are all dead trees with rotten branches and leaves.
I don’t know if it’s because the Bone Burial Mound really has a lot of bones, but the stones on the ground all look white.
